verdict.rationale: PostHog's own docs cover both halves of the story. The data warehouse syncs sources like Postgres and queries them alongside events in SQL, and batch exports schedule recurring data exports, which the query docs name as the supported path for bulk or recurring export. Realtime destinations add continuous outbound delivery. Missing for 10: named warehouse export destinations (e.g. Snowflake/BigQuery/S3) in the evidence, details of batch export cadence and configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync events between the platform and my own data warehouse (query warehouse tables in-product or export events continuously to it)

citations.quote: Sync Stripe, Postgres, Salesforce, HubSpot, and dozens of other sources, then query them alongside your events, persons, and sessions in one SQL query
Batch exports give you a platform to schedule data exports to supported destinations.
sends the result wherever it needs to go – in realtime or on a schedule.
